pages.title: Crafting the Gear
pages.text:
Every material has a **sword, dagger, scythe, spear, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, and shield**.

Tools and armor use the same shapes as vanilla, with the material in place of iron. See [Daggers and Scythes](entry://getting_started/daggers_scythes) for the two new weapons.

pages.title: Shields and Upgrades
pages.text:
The **shield** is a vanilla shield with four of the material around it, one on each side.

Infernium is the exception: it's an upgrade at a smithing table, like netherite.
